title: On the structure of complete $G_2$-solitons
summary: In this work, we establish compactness and regularity results for complete gradient Laplacian solitons of closed $G_2$-structures. Under a lower scalar-curvature bound and a distance-dependent bound on the gradient of the soliton potential, we prove pointed measured Gromov-Hausdorff compactness. With a uniform lower bound for the localised Perelman entropy, the Gromov-Hausdorff convergence improves to pointed $C^{1,α}$ convergence.
